reconcile.note: Adam Clarke reconciles the reports by distinguishing idolatrous high places Jehoshaphat destroyed from Yahweh-consecrated ones he left standing.

sides.snippet: the high places were not taken away; the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.
sides.verseText: He walked in all the way of Asa his father; He didn't turn aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of Yahweh: however the high places were not taken away; the people still sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.

sides.snippet: he took away the high places and the Asherim out of Judah.
sides.verseText: His heart was lifted up in the ways of Yahweh: and furthermore he took away the high places and the Asherim out of Judah.
